Wregals is India's first premium, capital-backed digital auction house focused exclusively on celebrity-owned, rare, and authenticated memorabilia. The platform operates under an English Open Ascending Auction model — bids are public, prices increase incrementally, and the highest valid bid at closing wins.

Wregals is not a marketplace. It is an institutional-grade auction house. Only KYC-verified, financially backed participants may bid. Every item is authenticated before listing, physically inspected by Wregals before delivery, and escrow-protected throughout.

Wregals operates a dual-fee model — revenue is earned from both the buyer and the seller on every completed transaction. The design ensures neither side bears the full platform cost, and the embedded buyer premium creates a cleaner user experience by eliminating post-auction price surprises.

A 9% buyer premium is charged on every winning bid. This premium is already included in the bid prices displayed to buyers throughout the auction — it is never shown as a separate line item. The price a buyer sees is the price they pay (before GST on the premium).
The buyer never sees '₹X + 9% premium'. They just see a final price. This reduces price shock, increases bid acceptance, and creates a cleaner auction experience.

5.3.2 Incremental Hold When Raising Own Bid
Do NOT freeze a fresh 10% when a user raises their own bid. Freeze only the additional amount needed to reach 10% of the new bid. This prevents wallet depletion for active bidders.
// Incremental hold logic — runs when user raises their existing bid
Example: User bid ₹1,00,000 → ₹10,000 frozen. User raises to ₹1,20,000 → new requirement ₹12,000 → freeze only additional ₹2,000 → total held = ₹12,000.

A buyer may bid on multiple auctions concurrently. Each auction holds its own independent 10% freeze. The wallet must have enough available balance to cover the cumulative total of all active holds across all auctions.

VALID return (item materially different from listing, or damaged in transit): Wregals representative collects item from buyer's address after verifying defects. Buyer receives 100% refund to Wregals Wallet within 48 hours of collection. Transfer to original bank source may take 3–5 additional business days for amounts above ₹5,00,000.

INVALID return (buyer's remorse; item matches pre-shipment evidence): Return declined. T&C state clearly that Wregals inspects every item before shipment and buyer agreed to these terms at onboarding.

Required under Consumer Protection Act, 2019. Protecting buyers from genuine fraud or transit damage increases trust → higher bids. Pre-shipment photo/video evidence is the definitive record and makes frivolous returns easy to decline.
